svg.text: WLD 205 DAY 9 — PARALLEL RECHECK BANK
Instructor selects ONE new item in the student's weakest remaining domain.
BLUEPRINT / SOURCE RECHECKS
B1. A drawing shows “UNITS: INCHES” in the title block. What source controls the units?
Expected: the drawing/title block.
B2. A print says “WELD PER APPROVED WPS.” Where do procedure conditions come from?
Expected: the approved WPS/SWPS.
B3. A weld symbol is unclear. What is the next action?
Expected: stop and check the authorized source/instructor; do not guess.
Pass evidence: correct source identified without prompting.
MATH / TOLERANCE RECHECKS
Expected: 3 7/8 in.
M2. Convert 9/16 in to decimal.
Expected: 0.5625 in.
M3. 4.000 ± 0.010 in, actual 4.012 in. Accept or reject?
Expected: reject. Limits = 3.990–4.010 in.
Pass evidence: work shown, units included, decision based on written limits.
MATERIAL-BEHAVIOR / SOURCE-CONTROL RECHECKS
R1. Which property describes resistance to indentation?
Expected: hardness.
R2. Which zone is heat affected but did not melt?
Expected: HAZ.
R3. Can exact alloy grade be identified from appearance alone?
Expected: no; use source documentation/marking/MTR/project specification.
Pass evidence: supported conclusion stated without inventing exact material facts.
Do not recheck a strong domain. One clean independent parallel item is enough.
